tool_schemas.name: get_profiles
tool_schemas.description: Lists profiles in the given account and returns a paged collection of profile records filtered by the provided exact-match identifiers (email/phone/external_id), status, and created/updated timestamp ranges, sorted by the requested field; pagination uses limit and an opaque cursor to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when filters are malformed (including invalid date-time values, limit out of range, or an unknown sort), and UNAUTHORIZED when the caller is not allowed to access the specified account. Raises NOT_FOUND when account_id does not correspond to an existing account, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request rate or account quotas prevent listing.

account_id.description: Klaviyo account id to scope profiles to (klv_acct_... ULID).

email.description: Filter profiles by exact email address.

phone.description: Filter profiles by exact phone number.

external_id.description: Filter profiles by exact external id.

created_at_gte.description: Filter profiles created at or after this timestamp (ISO 8601).

created_at_lte.description: Filter profiles created at or before this timestamp (ISO 8601).

updated_at_gte.description: Filter profiles updated at or after this timestamp (ISO 8601).

updated_at_lte.description: Filter profiles updated at or before this timestamp (ISO 8601).

limit.description: Maximum number of profiles to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: get_profile
tool_schemas.description: Fetches and returns a single profile by profile_id. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when profile_id is malformed, and NOT_FOUND when no profile exists for the given id. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when the caller is not allowed to read that profile, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request rate or account quotas prevent retrieval.

tool_schemas.name: create_profile
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new profile under the specified account and returns the created profile record with its assigned profile_id and timestamps. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields are missing, enum values are invalid (status), or attribute types are not acceptable, and NOT_FOUND when account_id does not correspond to an existing account. Raises CONFLICT when a profile already exists in the account with the same unique identifier (email, phone, or external_id), UNAUTHORIZED when the caller cannot create profiles for the account, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when account or rate limits prevent creation.

account_id.description: Klaviyo account id that will own the profile (klv_acct_... ULID).

external_id.description: External identifier for the profile (e.g., your user id).

location.description: Location object for the profile (free-form JSON).

properties.description: Custom properties for the profile (free-form JSON).

consent.description: Consent object for the profile (free-form JSON).

tool_schemas.name: update_profile
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing profile and returns the updated profile record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when profile_id is malformed, provided fields fail validation (including invalid status), or the request contains unsupported properties, and NOT_FOUND when the profile does not exist. Raises CONFLICT when updating email/phone/external_id would collide with another profile’s identifier in the same account, UNAUTHORIZED when the caller cannot update the profile, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when account or rate limits prevent the update.

email.description: Updated email address for the profile.

phone.description: Updated phone number for the profile.

external_id.description: Updated external identifier for the profile.

tool_schemas.name: delete_profile
tool_schemas.description: Deletes a profile according to delete_mode: "hard" removes the profile, while "request" marks it as deletion_requested, and returns the resulting profile state. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when profile_id or delete_mode is invalid, and NOT_FOUND when the profile does not exist. Raises CONFLICT when the requested deletion is not allowed for the profile’s current status (for example, requesting deletion for an already deleted profile), UNAUTHORIZED when the caller cannot delete the profile, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when account or rate limits prevent the operation.

delete_mode.description: Deletion behavior: hard deletes the profile; request marks it as deletion_requested.

tool_schemas.name: get_lists
tool_schemas.description: Lists list-type audiences for the given account and returns a paged collection filtered by exact name and status, sorted by the requested field; pagination uses limit and an opaque cursor. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when limit/sort/status are invalid, and NOT_FOUND when account_id does not correspond to an existing account. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when the caller is not allowed to access the specified account, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request rate or account quotas prevent listing.

account_id.description: Klaviyo account id to scope lists to (klv_acct_... ULID).

limit.description: Maximum number of lists to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: get_list
tool_schemas.description: Fetches and returns a single list audience by list_id. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when list_id is malformed, and NOT_FOUND when no audience exists for the id or the audience is not a list. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when the caller is not allowed to read the list, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request rate or account quotas prevent retrieval.

list_id.description: Audience id for the list to fetch (klv_aud_... ULID).

tool_schemas.name: create_list
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new list audience in the specified account and returns the created list record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields are missing or invalid (including status), and NOT_FOUND when account_id does not correspond to an existing account. Raises CONFLICT when another list in the account already uses the same name, UNAUTHORIZED when the caller cannot create lists for the account, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when account or rate limits prevent creation.

account_id.description: Klaviyo account id that will own the list (klv_acct_... ULID).

tool_schemas.name: add_profiles_to_list
tool_schemas.description: Adds the provided profile_ids as members of the specified list and returns the updated membership result for the operation. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when any id fails its required format, profile_ids is empty, or the list_id does not refer to a list-type audience, and NOT_FOUND when the account, list, or any referenced profile does not exist within the account. Raises CONFLICT when membership cannot be created due to current resource state (for example, profiles that are deleted), UNAUTHORIZED when the caller cannot modify the list, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when account or rate limits prevent the update.

account_id.description: Account ULID that owns the list and profiles.

list_id.description: Audience id for the target list (audiences.type must be 'list').

profile_ids.description: Profile ids to add as members of the list.

tool_schemas.name: get_segments
tool_schemas.description: Lists segment-type audiences for the given account and returns a paged collection filtered by status and optional case-insensitive search over name/description, sorted by the requested field; pagination uses limit and an opaque cursor. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when limit/sort/status are invalid, and NOT_FOUND when account_id does not correspond to an existing account. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when the caller is not allowed to access the specified account, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request rate or account quotas prevent listing.

account_id.description: Account ULID to scope segments to.

limit.description: Maximum number of segments to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get_segment
tool_schemas.description: Returns a single audience of type "segment" owned by the given account_id, including the segment’s stored definition and metadata. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if account_id/segment_id are malformed or if the referenced audience is not a segment, NOT_FOUND if no matching segment exists for that account, and FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to read audiences for the account.

account_id.description: Account ULID that owns the segment.

segment_id.description: Audience id for the segment (audiences.type must be 'segment').

tool_schemas.name: get_events
tool_schemas.description: Lists events for an account, optionally filtered by profile_id, metric_id, event_time range (since/until), status, and source, and returns results sorted as requested. Results are paged with limit (1–200) and an opaque cursor; provide the returned cursor to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filters (including malformed IDs, invalid timestamps, since > until, or unsupported sort/status), FORBIDDEN if you cannot read events for the account, and NOT_FOUND if a provided profile_id or metric_id does not exist in the account.

account_id.description: Account ULID to scope events to.

since.description: Return events with event_time greater than or equal to this timestamp.

until.description: Return events with event_time less than this timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: create_event
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new event instance attributed to a profile and metric in the given account and returns the created event record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing/invalid (including malformed IDs, non‑RFC3339 event_time, or non-object event_properties), NOT_FOUND if the profile_id or metric_id does not exist in the account, and FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to write events for the account.

account_id.description: Account ULID that owns the event.

profile_id.description: Profile id the event is attributed to.

metric_id.description: Metric id that this event instance belongs to.

event_value.description: Optional numeric value associated with the event (e.g., revenue).

tool_schemas.name: get_metrics
tool_schemas.description: Lists metrics for an account, optionally filtered by status and a case-insensitive search on metric_name, and returns metrics sorted as requested. Results are paged with limit (1–200) and an opaque cursor for the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid status/sort/limit or malformed account_id, and FORBIDDEN if you cannot read metrics for the account.

account_id.description: Account ULID to scope metrics to.

limit.description: Maximum number of metrics to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get_metric
tool_schemas.description: Returns a single metric by metric_id within the specified account_id. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if account_id or metric_id are malformed, NOT_FOUND if the metric does not exist in that account, and FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to read metrics for the account.

account_id.description: Account ULID that owns the metric.

tool_schemas.name: get_campaigns
tool_schemas.description: Lists campaigns for an account, optionally filtered by lifecycle/status and a case-insensitive search across name/external_key, and returns campaigns sorted as requested. Results are paged with limit (1–200) and an opaque cursor for the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid status/sort/limit or malformed account_id, and FORBIDDEN if you cannot read campaigns for the account.

account_id.description: Account ULID to scope campaigns to.

limit.description: Maximum number of campaigns to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get_campaign
tool_schemas.description: Returns a single campaign resource by campaign_id. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if campaign_id is malformed, NOT_FOUND if the campaign does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to read the owning account’s campaigns.

campaign_id.description: Campaign resource id (ULID with klv_res_ prefix).

tool_schemas.name: get_campaign_message
tool_schemas.description: Returns a single campaign message resource by campaign_message_id. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if campaign_message_id is malformed, NOT_FOUND if the campaign message does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to read messages for the owning account.

campaign_message_id.description: Campaign message resource id (ULID with klv_res_ prefix).

tool_schemas.name: get_campaign_messages
tool_schemas.description: Lists messages for a given campaign_id and returns them sorted as requested. Results are paged with limit (1–200) and an opaque cursor for the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed campaign_id or invalid sort/limit, NOT_FOUND if the campaign does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to read the campaign’s messages.

campaign_id.description: Campaign resource id to list messages for.

limit.description: Maximum number of campaign messages to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

sort.description: Sort order for returned campaign messages.

tool_schemas.name: get_campaign_recipient_estimation
tool_schemas.description: Returns an estimated recipient count for the specified campaign based on its current targeting and state. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if campaign_id is malformed, NOT_FOUND if the campaign does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to read the campaign.

campaign_id.description: Campaign resource id to estimate recipients for.

tool_schemas.name: get_campaign_metrics
tool_schemas.description: Returns time-bounded delivery and engagement metrics for the specified campaign, optionally constrained by start_time (inclusive) and end_time (exclusive), and returns a single aggregated metrics payload (not paged). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if campaign_id is not in the expected format or if start_time/end_time are not valid RFC 3339 date-times (or end_time is not after start_time), and raises NOT_FOUND if the campaign does not exist or is not accessible in the caller’s account. Raises FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to view the campaign’s analytics and RATE_LIMITED if analytics query limits are exceeded.

campaign_id.description: Campaign resource id to fetch metrics for.

start_time.description: Start of the time range (inclusive) for campaign metrics.

end_time.description: End of the time range (exclusive) for campaign metrics.

tool_schemas.name: query_metric_aggregates
tool_schemas.description: Computes aggregates over events for the given metric_id across the requested time range, bucketed by interval and optionally grouped by the requested group_by fields, returning an array of time buckets with the chosen statistic. The results are not cursor-paged; the response contains only the aggregates for the specified range/interval/grouping. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid ids, timestamps, unsupported interval/statistic/group_by values, unknown filter fields, or an invalid time window; raises NOT_FOUND if the metric does not exist or is not accessible; raises FORBIDDEN for insufficient permissions and RATE_LIMITED when event/analytics aggregation quotas are exceeded.

metric_id.description: Metric id (ULID with klv_met_ prefix) to aggregate.

start_time.description: Start of the time range (inclusive) for aggregation.

end_time.description: End of the time range (exclusive) for aggregation.

interval.description: Time bucketing interval for the aggregates.

statistic.description: Aggregate statistic to compute over matching events.

group_by.description: Optional fields to group aggregates by.

profile_id.description: Restrict aggregation to a single profile.

source.description: Restrict aggregation to events from a specific source.

tool_schemas.name: get_campaign_performance
tool_schemas.description: Returns computed performance summaries for the specified campaign over an optional time window (start_time inclusive, end_time exclusive), such as rates derived from delivery and engagement counts, in a single non-paged response. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if campaign_id is malformed, timestamps are invalid, or the time window is invalid, and raises NOT_FOUND if the campaign cannot be found or does not belong to the caller’s account. Raises FORBIDDEN when the caller is not permitted to read campaign reporting and RATE_LIMITED when reporting query limits are exceeded.

campaign_id.description: Campaign resource id to fetch performance for.

start_time.description: Start of the time range (inclusive) for performance calculations.

end_time.description: End of the time range (exclusive) for performance calculations.

tool_schemas.name: get_flows
tool_schemas.description: Lists flows for an account, optionally filtered by lifecycle status and sorted by the requested sort key, returning up to limit items and a next-page cursor when more results exist. Pagination is cursor-based: pass the returned cursor to fetch the next page, and omit cursor to start from the first page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid account_id, unsupported status/sort values, or out-of-range limit; raises NOT_FOUND if the account does not exist; raises FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot list flows for the account; and raises RATE_LIMITED when list/query limits are exceeded.

account_id.description: Account id to list flows for.

limit.description: Maximum number of flows to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get_flow
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single flow resource by flow_id within the given account_id and returns the flow object. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if identifiers are malformed, raises NOT_FOUND if the account or flow does not exist or the flow is not owned by the account, and raises FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks access to the account’s flows. Raises RATE_LIMITED if read limits are exceeded.

account_id.description: Account ULID (klv_acct_01H8...) that owns the flow.

tool_schemas.name: update_flow_status
tool_schemas.description: Updates a flow’s lifecycle status and returns the updated flow resource. Only the supported status values are accepted, and invalid state transitions are rejected (for example, attempting to activate an archived flow) with CONFLICT. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed identifiers or unsupported status, NOT_FOUND if the account or flow does not exist or does not belong to the account, FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot manage flows, and RATE_LIMITED if write limits are exceeded.

account_id.description: Account ULID (klv_acct_01H8...) that owns the flow.

status.description: New lifecycle status for the flow.

tool_schemas.name: get_templates
tool_schemas.description: Lists templates for an account, optionally filtered by status and sorted as requested, returning up to limit templates and a next-page cursor when additional results are available. Pagination is cursor-based: use cursor from the prior response to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid account_id, unsupported status/sort, or invalid limit; NOT_FOUND if the account does not exist; FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks access; and RATE_LIMITED when listing limits are exceeded.

account_id.description: Account ULID (klv_acct_01H8...) that owns the templates.

limit.description: Maximum number of templates to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get_template
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single template resource by template_id within the given account and returns the template object. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if identifiers are malformed, NOT_FOUND if the account or template does not exist or the template is not owned by the account, and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to read templates. Raises RATE_LIMITED if read limits are exceeded.

account_id.description: Account ULID (klv_acct_01H8...) that owns the template.

tool_schemas.name: create_template
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new template in the specified account and returns the created template resource, using external_key (when provided) for client-side idempotency and cross-system mapping. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing, status is unsupported, or body is not an object; raises CONFLICT if external_key is already in use for another template in the same account. Raises NOT_FOUND if the account does not exist, FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot create templates for the account, and RATE_LIMITED if write quotas are exceeded.

account_id.description: Account ULID (klv_acct_01H8...) that will own the template.

external_key.description: Client-provided external identifier for idempotency/cross-system mapping.

body.description: Template content payload (e.g., HTML/text/blocks and related rendering fields).

tool_schemas.name: get_catalogs
tool_schemas.description: Lists catalogs for an account, optionally filtered by status and sorted as requested, returning up to limit catalogs and a next-page cursor when more results exist. Pagination is cursor-based: supply cursor to retrieve the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid account_id, unsupported status/sort values, or an invalid limit; NOT_FOUND if the account does not exist; FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot access catalogs for the account; and RATE_LIMITED when listing limits are exceeded.

account_id.description: Account ULID (klv_acct_01H8...) that owns the catalogs.

limit.description: Maximum number of catalogs to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get_catalog_items
tool_schemas.description: Lists catalog items that belong to the given catalog in the specified account and returns a single page of results sorted as requested; use limit and the opaque cursor to paginate until no next cursor is returned. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if catalog_id/account_id are malformed, limit is out of range, or status/sort are not one of the allowed values; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot access the account. Raises NOT_FOUND if the catalog does not exist in the account or is not a catalog resource.

account_id.description: Account ULID (klv_acct_01H8...) that owns the catalog items.

catalog_id.description: Catalog resource ULID (klv_res_01H8...) whose items to list (resource_type='catalog').

limit.description: Maximum number of catalog items to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

sort.description: Sort order for returned catalog items.

tool_schemas.name: get_catalog_item
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single catalog item by ID and returns the catalog_item resource. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if account_id or catalog_item_id is malformed; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot access the account. Raises NOT_FOUND if the catalog item does not exist in the account or the ID is not a catalog_item resource.

account_id.description: Account ULID (klv_acct_01H8...) that owns the catalog item.

catalog_item_id.description: Catalog item resource ULID (klv_res_01H8...) to retrieve (resource_type='catalog_item').

tool_schemas.name: get_tags
tool_schemas.description: Lists tags for an account and returns a single page of tag resources; supports case-insensitive name search via q, filtering by status, sorting, and pagination via limit and cursor. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if account_id is malformed, limit is out of range, cursor is invalid, or status/sort are not allowed; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot access the account. Returns an empty page when no tags match.

account_id.description: Account ULID to scope the tag search.

limit.description: Maximum number of tags to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

q.description: Case-insensitive substring match on tag name.

tool_schemas.name: create_tag
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new tag in the account and returns the created tag resource, storing the provided name plus optional external_key, status, and body metadata. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if account_id is malformed, name is missing/empty, or status is not one of the allowed values; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot create tags in the account. Raises CONFLICT if a tag with the same external_key already exists in the account.

account_id.description: Account ULID that will own the tag.

external_key.description: Optional external identifier for the tag.

body.description: Optional tag metadata payload stored with the tag.

tool_schemas.name: add_tag_to_resource
tool_schemas.description: Assigns an existing tag to a target resource (including profiles) within the same account and returns the updated tagging relationship/target representation for the assignment. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any ID/type is malformed, or if target_resource_type is not one of the supported values; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot modify the target in the account. Raises NOT_FOUND if the tag or target resource does not exist in the account, and raises CONFLICT if the tag is already assigned to that target.

account_id.description: Account ULID that owns both the tag and the target resource.

target_resource_id.description: Target resource ULID to tag (resource ULID, or profile ULID when tagging a profile).

target_resource_type.description: Type of the target being tagged.

tool_schemas.name: get_webhooks
tool_schemas.description: Lists webhooks for an account and returns a single page of webhook resources; supports case-insensitive name search via q, filtering by status, sorting, and pagination via limit and cursor. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if account_id is malformed, limit is out of range, cursor is invalid, or status/sort are not allowed; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot access the account. Returns an empty page when no webhooks match.

account_id.description: Account ULID to scope the webhook search.

limit.description: Maximum number of webhooks to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

q.description: Case-insensitive substring match on webhook name.

tool_schemas.name: create_webhook
tool_schemas.description: Creates a webhook in the account and returns the created webhook resource, persisting the provided name, enablement status, and configuration body. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if account_id is malformed, name/body are missing, or status is not one of enabled|disabled; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot create webhooks in the account. Raises CONFLICT if a webhook with the same external_key already exists in the account.

account_id.description: Account ULID that will own the webhook.

external_key.description: Optional external identifier for the webhook.

body.description: Webhook configuration payload (e.g., destination URL, subscribed topics, secret).

tool_schemas.name: delete_webhook
tool_schemas.description: Deletes the specified webhook from the account and returns a deletion confirmation/empty response. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if account_id or webhook_id is malformed; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot delete webhooks in the account. Raises NOT_FOUND if the webhook does not exist in the account.

account_id.description: Account ULID that owns the webhook.

tool_schemas.name: request_profile_deletion
tool_schemas.description: Creates a profile deletion request for the specified profile and returns the created deletion-request resource, recording optional external_key and body metadata. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if account_id/profile_id are malformed; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot request deletions in the account. Raises NOT_FOUND if the profile does not exist in the account, and raises CONFLICT if there is already an active deletion request for the same profile or the external_key is already in use.

account_id.description: Account ULID where the profile exists.

profile_id.description: Profile ULID to request deletion for.

external_key.description: Optional external identifier for the deletion request.

body.description: Optional deletion request metadata (e.g., reason, requested_by, compliance identifiers).

tool_schemas.name: get_coupons
tool_schemas.description: Lists coupons for an account and returns a single page of coupon resources; supports case-insensitive name search via q, filtering by status, sorting, and pagination via limit and cursor. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if account_id is malformed, limit is out of range, cursor is invalid, or status/sort are not allowed; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot access the account. Returns an empty page when no coupons match.

account_id.description: Account ULID to scope the coupon search.

limit.description: Maximum number of coupons to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

q.description: Case-insensitive substring match on coupon name.

tool_schemas.name: create_coupon_code
tool_schemas.description: Creates a coupon for the specified account and returns the created coupon resource; at minimum you must provide a unique `code`, and fixed discounts require a supported `currency`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields are missing/invalid (including `account_id` format, enum values, `max_redemptions*` < 1, or `ends_at` earlier than `starts_at`), CONFLICT when a coupon with the same `code` (or provided `external_key`) already exists in the account, and NOT_FOUND when the `account_id` does not exist. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller cannot create coupons for the account and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when write limits for the account or token are exceeded.

account_id.description: Account ULID that will own the coupon resource.

body.description: Coupon fields to create on the coupon resource.

external_key.description: External system identifier for the coupon.

description.description: Description of the coupon and its intended use.

discount_type.description: Type of discount the coupon applies.

discount_value.description: Discount amount (percent value for percent; currency amount for fixed).

max_redemptions.description: Maximum number of times the coupon can be redeemed.

max_redemptions_per_profile.description: Maximum number of redemptions allowed per profile.

minimum_subtotal.description: Minimum order subtotal required to apply the coupon.

metadata.description: Arbitrary coupon metadata stored with the coupon.

tool_schemas.name: get_forms
tool_schemas.description: Lists forms for an account and returns a paged collection of form resources filtered by `status` and/or `external_key`, ordered by `sort`; pagination uses `limit` and an opaque `cursor` returned from the previous page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid `account_id`, unsupported `status`/`sort`, out-of-range `limit`, or an invalid/expired `cursor`. Raises NOT_FOUND if the `account_id` does not exist, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot read forms for the account, and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when read limits are exceeded.

account_id.description: Account ULID to list forms for.

limit.description: Maximum number of forms to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get_form
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single form by `form_id` and returns the form resource. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when `form_id` is not in the expected format and NOT_FOUND when no form exists for that id. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller does not have access to the owning account, and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when read limits are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: get_product_reviews
tool_schemas.description: Lists product reviews for an account and returns a paged collection of review resources filtered by `status`, `external_key`, and/or `profile_id`, ordered by `sort`; pagination uses `limit` and an opaque `cursor` for the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid ids, unsupported `status`/`sort`, out-of-range `limit`, or an invalid/expired `cursor`. Raises NOT_FOUND if the `account_id` does not exist (or if `profile_id` is provided but does not exist), UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot read reviews for the account, and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when read limits are exceeded.

account_id.description: Account ULID to list product reviews for.

profile_id.description: Filter reviews by author profile ULID.

limit.description: Maximum number of product reviews to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get_product_review
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single product review by `product_review_id` and returns the review resource. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when `product_review_id` is not in the expected format and NOT_FOUND when no product review exists for that id. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller does not have access to the owning account, and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when read limits are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: get_images
tool_schemas.description: Lists images for an account and returns a paged collection of image resources filtered by `status` and/or `external_key`, ordered by `sort`; pagination uses `limit` and an opaque `cursor` returned from the previous page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid `account_id`, unsupported `status`/`sort`, out-of-range `limit`, or an invalid/expired `cursor`. Raises NOT_FOUND if the `account_id` does not exist, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot read images for the account, and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when read limits are exceeded.

account_id.description: Account ULID to list images for.

limit.description: Maximum number of images to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get_image
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single image by `image_id` and returns the image resource. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when `image_id` is not in the expected format and NOT_FOUND when no image exists for that id. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller does not have access to the owning account, and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when read limits are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: get_identity
tool_schemas.description: Returns the calling identity for the presented credential, including the resolved account context, granted scopes, and current quota/rate-limit consumption. Refuses when the credential is missing, invalid, or expired. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when authentication fails and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when limits prevent the lookup.

api_key.description: API key credential used to authenticate (sent the same way as other endpoints for this service).
